lines.beaver_en: Hello, I'm Kim Sujin, a reporter from the Economic Daily.
lines.learner: 네, 반갑습니다. 가격 인상에 대해 말씀드릴게요.
lines.en: Yes, nice to meet you. I'll explain the price increase.
lines.roman: Ne, bangapseumnida. Gagyeok insange daehae malsseumdeurilkkeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Why has the price of coffee gone up so much lately?
lines.learner: 최근 수입 원두 가격이 급등했기 때문입니다.
lines.en: It's because imported coffee bean prices have soared recently.
lines.roman: Choegeun suip wondu gagyeogi geupdeunghaetkki ttaemunimnida.

lines.beaver_en: Why did the prices of imported goods go up?
lines.learner: 원두 공급이 줄어서 값이 크게 뛰었어요.
lines.en: The supply of coffee beans dropped, so prices jumped.
lines.roman: Wondu gonggeubi jureoseo gapssi keuge ttwieosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: And the supply? Why did it drop?
lines.en: Because of drought, most farms produced less.

lines.learner: 공급이 줄어드는 사이에 수요는 오히려 늘었어요.
lines.en: While supply was shrinking, demand actually grew.
lines.roman: Gonggeubi jureodeuneun saie suyoneun ohiryeo neureosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Were there problems in distribution too?
lines.learner: 네, 유통 비용 상승도 원인으로 꼽혀요.
lines.en: Yes, rising distribution costs are named as a cause too.
lines.roman: Ne, yutong biyong sangseungdo wonineuro kkopyeoyo.

lines.en: As the exchange rate rose, import costs grew too.
Coffee company stock prices actually went up.
They're less competitive than big companies, so I'm worried.

lines.beaver_en: Your explanation is very logical. Thank you.
lines.en: Thank you. I look forward to your article.
